sources: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 10362454 (search/campsites API, read 2026-10-28)

values.note: $25 a site (2026 and 2027 peak seasons). One RV with tow per site included; most sites take one extra vehicle for a per-night fee collected at the campground.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10362454/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-14 to 2026-10-18: Camping 25; 2027 the same) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10362454 (notice 'One RV with tow per single site or one vehicle per tent site. Most sites can accomidate 1 extra vehicle that is not included with the reservation. Extra vehicle will be charged a per night fee and collected at the campground.'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: 18 sites for tents, trailers, RVs and equestrian rigs, on gravel parking spurs; horse-trailer parking just inside the entrance. No vehicle length published.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10362454 ('Offers 18 sites suitable for tents, trailers, RVs, and equestrian rigs. The campground has well maintained gravel roads and parking spurs'; 'Horse trailer parking is available to the east just after entering the campground.') + recreation.gov catalog for 10362454 (18 STANDARD NONELECTRIC sites, no Max Vehicle Length), read 2026-10-28

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10362454 ('There is no potable water or hookups.') + recreation.gov catalog (all sites STANDARD NONELECTRIC, Water Hookup 'No'), read 2026-10-28

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10362454 ('Vault toilets and trash services are available. There is no potable water or hookups.'; amenities 'Trash Collection', 'Vault Toilets'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: 17 of 18 sites reservable on recreation.gov up to 2 days before arrival (site 6 'Not Available'). The site must be occupied the first night; a reserved site is held only until 11 a.m. the day after arrival. Check-in 2 p.m., check-out 11 a.m. 2026 reservation season May 14 - Oct 18.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10362454 (rules reservationCutOff 2; notices 'Campers must occupy the site the first night at a campsite.', 'Reserved Sites: Will be held until check out time (11:00am) the day following your arrival date', 'Check in time is 2:00pm and Check out time is 11:00am') + /rates (Peak Season 2026-05-14 to 2026-10-18) + recreation.gov catalog (17 sites reservable/Open, site 6 Not Available), read 2026-10-28

note: White River NF (Blanco RD) campground at ~7,600 ft in the South Fork valley, 29 mi east of Meeker via CO-13, Rio Blanco County Roads 8 and 10, beside the South Fork of the White River among spruce, cottonwood and willow, adjacent to the Flat Tops Wilderness. Trailheads to the wilderness and Spring Cave (open April 15 - August 15, registration required) nearby. --Claude
summary: recreation.gov listing + catalog: confirmed 18 sites, reservable, $25, no hookups. Added no potable water, vault toilets, trash, 2-day booking cutoff, reservation season May 14 - Oct 18, first-night occupancy rule, equestrian rigs/horse-trailer parking, fees checked 2026. Note rewritten: field facts dropped, directions and setting added.
flags: Website: no Forest Service page found for this campground (whiteriver camping-cabins index and slug guesses 404); the stored recreation.gov listing is the only official page.

Phone missing: Blanco Ranger District (970) 878-4039 (https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/offices; also recreation.gov's facility phone). recreation.gov's customer-service line is the concessionaire's: 'Customer Service Contact 801-226-3564 or Help.WhiteRiver.Blanco@AmericanLL.com'.
Operator: concessionaire (American Land & Leisure, per recreation.gov's contact email) on White River NF land; ownership left federal.
Length: no agency figure (recreation.gov describes 'well maintained gravel roads and parking spurs' and equestrian rigs; catalog has no lengths). Nothing singles the campground out for small rigs.
Road: access is ~28 mi of Rio Blanco County Roads 8 and 10 from CO-13; no agency wording on surface or 4WD. No FS alerts found naming the campground or CR 8/10.

Waterfront (stored riverview, kept; upgrade lead): the recreation.gov catalog tags every one of the 18 sites 'Riverfront' and the description says fishing access 'right beside the campground' (type-level tags prove nothing on their own). On Esri imagery the South Fork (~10-15 m wide, river-sized) runs west/southwest of the loop road; the southern sites sit ~20-35 m from the main channel and the central sites ~25 m from a side channel, through willow/cottonwood. Worth a per-site look for riverside on the southern sites.
Pin 39.867,-107.53407 = recreation.gov's facility point, on a parking pad by the loop road; fine. The catalog has no site coordinates.
